Herdify | Bristol, UK | Hybrid/Onsite | Full Time

Herdify is a young B2B SaaS company based in Bristol building a product to deliver behavioural science to consumer brands.

We are looking for a skilled Python Developer/Software Engineer with strong backend and automation experience to help develop our platform. You will be working on all areas of our platform BESeen, including internal tools, infrastructure management, frontend/backend development of our internal and external web portals, data processing/validation and more.

More info at https://herdify.com Apply here https://herdify.jobs.personio.com/job/2526942
